reference: dettato 2.0.0 at 51ade0f09f2272f4674166026582185d26baaeaf, --device cpu, float32, deterministic algorithms, four intra-op threads, one inter-op thread, repairer bypassed
upstream_spread: spread.json: upstream's own cpu run against its own cuda (bfloat16) run, same fixtures. A GPU backend of the port may not be worse than this spread on any gate, per fixture; a gate below is the CPU-backend limit and also the GPU limit wherever the spread is inside it.

fed_tensors.note: each stage is given its captured input

added_by_slice_1_not_in_the_plan.taps_float16: sub.tap.hidden and sub.tap.stem: |a - b| <= 0.001 + 2^-10 * |reference| elementwise (one float16 rounding step)
added_by_slice_1_not_in_the_plan.grouper_int8_features: grouper.feat codes within +-1 of the reference, grouper.fsc scales within one float16 step, grouper.meta max abs error < 0.001
added_by_slice_1_not_in_the_plan.grouper_embeddings: grouper.emb and grouper.win.emb max abs error < 0.001 (unit vectors)

notes_from_audio.match: one to one on pitch and voice slot, onset within 10 ms (half a 20 ms frame)
notes_from_audio.gpu: the stricter of this and the spread on the same fixture

drums.hits: same key and exact 20 ms frame, F1 at least 0.99, velocity within 2
drums.orchestral_branch: validate mode decodes both branches; captures hold drum_branches for both (result.json)
drums.skipped_source: a source under 40 kHz skips the drum model and writes no drum track

grouper.host_decode_given_captured_embeddings: every note in the same track, exactly (grouper.emb, grouper.probs, grouper.win.*, groups in result.json)
grouper.gpu: the spread on the same fixture where lower

unchanged: MuScriptor --validate-midi stays byte-identical; engine hand-offs carry the engine-smoke receipt
exception_policy: No looser tolerance preapproved. Report a failing stage and the measured error before proposing an exception.
